eligibility_evidence: Industry certifications such as: CCNA / CCNP Network+ DevNet AWS/Azure networking certifications Experience with SD-WAN, cloud networking, or hybrid infrastructure environments.
We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, among other factors.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate combines networking expertise with strong scripting and infrastructure automation skills to improve operational efficiency, scalability, reliability, and compliance. Ensure network infrastructure adheres to banking security, compliance, and regulatory requirements. 2+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering or infrastructure operations. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols, including: TCP/IP BGP OSPF VLANs STP DNS DHCP VPN technologies Routing and switching concepts Hands-on experience with network automation and scripting using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ansible.
